Battery Tracker.note: Only reads the Steam Deck battery at /sys/class/power_supply/BAT1, so it records nothing here.

DeckSP.note: Runs JamesDSP from Flathub; the DDC/VDC preset and the IRS, Liveprog and VDC file pickers use /home/deck paths, which don't exist here.

Decky Translator.note: The shortcut buttons read the Steam Deck controller over hidraw, and the offline OCR engine is a download built for Python 3.13 (Kettle has 3.11); cloud OCR and translation work.

Decky-Clipper.note: Records with the VA-API H.264 encoder (vah264enc), which Adreno and Mali GPUs don't have.

Discord Status.note: Needs a running Discord desktop client with Rich Presence, and the official Discord app is x86_64-only.

EmuDecky.note: Controls an EmuDeck install at /home/deck/.config/EmuDeck; EmuDeck itself targets x86 SteamOS.

HueSync.note: Only drives the LEDs of x86 handhelds (ASUS, Legion, MSI, AYANEO, OneXPlayer, GPD); Kettle's LED names aren't on its list.

Junk-Store.note: Its Epic store installs a legendary.flatpak bundle from GitHub that appears to be built for x86_64 only, so login and installs fail.

MoonDeck.note: Starts the Moonlight Flatpak with --arch=x86_64; a custom Moonlight executable path avoids this.

Muon.note: Builds its hotspot tools (hostapd, dnsmasq) from x86_64 packages off the SteamOS mirror into a system extension.

TunnelDeck.note: Switching NetworkManager VPN connections works; the OpenVPN option downloads an x86_64 SteamOS package and installs it as a sysext, which fails.
